plan: Queue offlane as primary. It is Mr_Meat31's best role at 53.6% over 148 games (overall is 51.6%). Set support as secondary, not the other way around.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Murdock and Phase. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Mr_Meat31 wins about 4.2 and 4.3 more games per 100 on them.
Mr_Meat31's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Mr_Meat31 is at 733 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 867.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 78%. Past 32: 38%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 7 of 9 short games vs 3 of 8 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Mr_Meat31
insights.finding: Right after a loss Mr_Meat31 wins 50%; right after a win, 64%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 5/10 after losses vs 7/11 after wins, last 22 games

insights.title: Phase is not just Mr_Meat31's best hero, it is the most disciplined
insights.finding: On Phase Mr_Meat31 dies 2.7/game vs a 3.7 average. The winrate edge is partly a discipline edge; that habit can travel to other picks.
insights.receipt: 105 games on Phase, 52.2% shrunk vs field 47.9%

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 is running hotter than the career line
insights.finding: The last 20 games are 60% against a 52% career. Whatever changed recently, keep it.
insights.receipt: 12/20 recent wins vs 51.6% over 1037 career games

insights.title: Murdock is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 157 games and Mr_Meat31 genuinely out-pilots the field on Murdock — about 4.2 more wins per 100 games than the average Murdock player. The hours show.
